g.text: A replay lane needs three inputs before it applies a packet;
the BBO replay core needs every lane
03 §4.5 · replay dependencies of one replica · arrows mean "must be applied first"
lane l applies the packet at LaneSeq x, x+1, …
BBO replay applies step s once
(a Shed step applies no match: its lane releases the reservation)
no cycle: a packet's fills_applied names only steps
whose cut is below that packet's first_lane_seq
